body:
Aaaaaand anotha one...

Map Info:
Small sized map with lots of little, original parts.
2 monuments and a few diamond blocks spread out over the map. (Not hidden!)
Islands are quite far away from eachother, so it's harder to bridge over.

replies.body:
Not sure about that, it's quite a small map, so it doesn't take much time to get there...
Also, making a good defence on this map takes time... A lot of time :P
I even think the attackers have an advantage on here, instead of the defending team.

I'll try to test it multiple times, to see how the gameplay is, to be sure <3

replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Waves, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest that you move the monuments further away from spawn, since currently, the monuments are hard to push.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, message me on Skype (downfallgaming123)

You may resubmit your map once edited.
